Header.title: ADL Digihouse
Header.paragraph: Your Trusted Digital Printing Partner - High-Quality Digital Printing Services in Colombo

About.paragraph: ADL Digihouse is a professional digital printing service provider located in Borella, Colombo. We specialize in high-quality printing solutions including screen printing, banners, mugs, ID cards, and authorized NIC and passport photography services. With years of experience and state-of-the-art equipment, we deliver exceptional results for individuals, businesses, and institutions.

Services.name: Event Management
Services.text: Comprehensive event planning, management, and promotional setup services for corporate, institutional, and private events.

Services.name: Screen Printing
Services.text: High-quality screen printing for T-shirts, uniforms, and promotional items. Durable prints that last long and maintain vibrant colors.

Services.name: Banner Printing
Services.text: Custom indoor and outdoor banners in any size. Perfect for events, promotions, and business advertising with weather-resistant materials.

Services.name: Mug Printing
Services.text: Personalized mugs for gifts, corporate giveaways, and special occasions. High-quality prints that are dishwasher safe and long-lasting.

Services.name: ID Card Printing
Services.text: Plastic ID cards, membership cards, barcode cards, and visitor passes with professional finishes. Suitable for institutions, offices, and organizations.

Services.name: NIC & Passport Photo Online
Services.text: Authorized online NIC and passport photo capture and digital submission services compliant with official standards.

Services.name: Flex & Sticker
Services.text: High-quality flex and sticker printing for signage, branding, and promotions. Weather-resistant materials with vivid colors.

Services.name: Books, Leaflets & Brochures
Services.text: Design and print books, leaflets, and brochures with premium paper options and professional binding.

Services.name: Pin-on Badges
Services.text: Custom pin-on badges for events, schools, and organizations. Durable materials and clear printing.

Services.name: T-shirts & Caps
Services.text: Branded T-shirts and caps with screen printing or heat transfer. Perfect for teams and promotions.

Services.name: Visiting Cards
Services.text: Professional visiting cards with premium finishes and custom designs.

Services.name: Certificates
Services.text: Official certificates with high-quality printing and emboss options.

Services.name: Greeting & Invitation Cards
Services.text: Custom greeting and invitation cards for weddings, events, and special occasions.

Services.name: Letter Heads
Services.text: Professional letter heads for businesses with crisp printing and quality paper.

Services.name: Photo Printing & Group Photography
Services.text: High-quality photo prints and group photography services for events and institutions.
